buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 2. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers

for Service Support. 4. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder should submit an undertaking that the bidder's firm has not been black listed / debarred / prohi bited by any State / Central Government Departments / Organizations. The undertaking should be on Sta mp paper worth of 100 INR. after bid published date. A Letter of consent is to be uploaded mandatory from the seller in ATC that we have followed all the terms and conditions, o​therwise bid will not be considered. The service provider firm must have obtained ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 27001:2013, and SA 8 000:2014 certifications, along with the ISO 9001:2015 audit report, before the publication of the tender. R egistration must be completed prior to the tender publication, and the relevant documents must be uploa ded along with the bid. The tenderer must mandatorily attach a valid Character Certificate District Magistrate’s Office and a solve ncy Certificate of 60 Lakh issued by the District Magistrate’s/Bank Office. The Integrity Pledge Certificate issued by the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) must be uploaded. The tenderer must submit one Demand Draft (DD) / Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR), pledged in the name of t he Director, Electrical Safety, Lucknow along with the relevant bank certificate. The tender participation shall not be considered valid if the service provider agency uploads unnecessary or invalid documents. Duration of service contract may be extended further beyond the initial contract duration (subject to satisf actory performance and mutual consent). The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity if required by the buyer. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingly. . 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Human Resource Service Continuity of resources deployed by Service Provider: Successful Service provider will ensure continuity of any allocated / deployed resources with the prior consent of the buyer department. Deployed resources cannot be replaced by Service Provider without prior approval of buyer. Any replacement will also be provided through Sewayojan Portal only.

8. Human Resource Service Deployment of Existing working / deployed resources: 29 number of Existing working / deployed resources of the procurement department having job satisfactory certificate, will be continued by the successful Service Provider under the new contract also – subject to their consent to the Terms and conditions of new contract concluded on the basis of this bid. 9. Human Resource Service Recruitment mandated through Sewayojan Portal: Recruitment of candidates is mandated through Sewayojan Portal (url:www.sewayojan.up.nic.in). Successful bidder / Service Provider has to select candidates registered on the Sewayojan Portal only for deployment under this contract. As such successful Service provider will have to make available adequate number of candidates / resources registered on sewayojan portal for selection / short listings by the Buyer department For 1 employee selection five times and for 2 or more than 2 employees to be three times, subject to the min of 10 candidates.
